title: ANEForge: Python for direct computation on the Apple Neural Engine
abstract: arXiv:2606.17090v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: ANEForge is a Python package that programs the Apple Neural Engine (ANE), the fixed-function neural accelerator on every recent Apple device, directly and without CoreML. In production the engine is reachable only through CoreML, which treats it as a scheduling option: no configuration requires the ANE, and a model can silently run on the CPU or GPU instead. ANEForge compiles a lazy tensor graph, built from 58 fused operators and 19 native bridge operators, into a single ANE program. The program is dispatched through the same ANE daemon and kernel-driver stack as Apple's internal framework. Beyond inference, the package reaches the engine's native fused attention, streams int8, int4, and sparse weights, keeps decoder and optimizer state resident across steps, and runs the forward pass, backward pass, and optimizer update of training on the engine. A small fused program completes a call in about 90us, near the engine's 70us per-

translated_title: ANEForge：用于在苹果神经引擎上进行直接计算的Python包
translated_abstract: ANEForge是一个Python包，它绕过CoreML直接对苹果神经引擎（ANE）进行编程，ANE是苹果近期所有设备上搭载的固定功能神经加速器。在生产环境中，该引擎只能通过CoreML访问，而CoreML仅将其视为一种调度选项：没有任何配置强制使用ANE，模型可能会悄无声息地在CPU或GPU上运行。ANEForge将由58个融合算子和19个原生桥接算子构建的惰性张量图编译为单一的ANE程序，该程序通过与苹果内部框架相同的ANE守护进程和内核驱动程序栈进行调度分发。除推理之外，该包还能调用引擎原生的融合注意力机制，支持int8、int4和稀疏权重的流式传输，在多个步骤间保持解码器和优化器状态的驻留，并能在引擎上运行训练的前向传播、反向传播和优化器更新。一个小型融合程序完成一次调用约需90微秒，接近引擎每次约70微秒的……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: ANEForge是一个绕过CoreML直接编程苹果神经引擎的Python包，可将融合算子图编译为单一ANE程序，并支持原生融合注意力、低精度稀疏权重流式加载以及引擎上的完整训练流程。
en_tdlr: ANEForge is a Python package that bypasses CoreML to directly program the Apple Neural Engine, compiling fused-operator tensor graphs into a single ANE program while enabling native fused attention, streaming low-precision and sparse weights, and full training loops on the engine.
